meta.name: team-communication-protocols
meta.description: Structured messaging protocols for agent team communication including message type selection, plan approval, shutdown procedures, and anti-patterns to avoid. Use this skill when establishing communication norms for a newly spawned team, when deciding whether to send a direct message or a broadcast, when a team-lead needs to review and approve an implementer's plan before work begins, when orchestrating a graceful team shutdown after all tasks are complete, or when debugging why teammates are not coordinating correctly at integration points.

copy.tagline: 规范智能体团队的沟通与协作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发多智能体系统,需要统一团队通信规则
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building multi-agent systems and need clear messaging protocols.

howto.what: 它给 Claude 的智能体团队定下通信规矩:默认发定向消息,广播只用于关键共享变更,并管理计划审批、优雅关停和要避开的通信反模式。
howto.when: 当你为新团队确立沟通方式、决定用定向消息还是广播,或要审批实现者的计划并让团队有序收尾时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新团队定一套沟通规则
say.note: 默认定向消息,广播只留关键共享变更

say.text: 看一下实现者-1 的计划,先不批准,让它补上错误处理
所有任务都完成了,让每个队友优雅关停
say.note: 逐个发 shutdown_request,全部退出后再删团队

howto.what_en: It gives Claude's agent team a messaging protocol: direct messages by default, broadcasts only for critical shared changes, plus plan approval, graceful shutdown, and anti-patterns to avoid.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting communication norms for a new team, choosing between a direct message and a broadcast, or approving an implementer's plan and shutting the team down cleanly.

say_en.text: Help me set up communication rules for this new team
say_en.note: Direct messages by default; broadcasts for critical changes

say_en.text: Review implementer-1's plan; reject it and ask for error handling
All tasks are done — shut down each teammate gracefully
say_en.note: Sends shutdown_request to each, then deletes the team
